Purpose: measure whether a question about the *current* architecture and
the *latest* review surfaces the authoritative, most-recent documents
rather than drifting into the large truncated roadmap (planned-work.md) or
code. Expectations are hand-verified against docs/architecture.md section
headings and the newest findings document (the 2026-07-26 read-only review).
Recorded baseline (2026-07-23, before authority-aware doc anchoring/caps):
Task A current-architecture : node_recall 0.167 (1/6), mrr 0.026, status partial
Historical Task B baseline  : node_recall 1.000,        mrr 0.023, status partial
Task A shows the drift directly (architecture.md contributes ~1 node); Task
B shows the newest cycle doc is present but buried (~rank 44). Promote these
tasks into eval/graphgraph-self.json only once tuning lifts recall AND rank
(the T11 acceptance bar), so the regression suite never carries a red target.
